ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: The large shark is known as what?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The image shows a marine food chain: sunlight shines into the water, arrows point in sequence from one-celled life to shrimplike creatures, then to small fish, then to mackerel and tuna, and finally there is an arrow leading to a large shark labeled large shark at the lower left. Reasoning: In a food chain, animals that are located later and eat other animals are called predators. The large shark is at the end of the food chain and will prey on other fish, therefore large shark is known as a predator.
